description: Numeric keys of MetricCollector.get_metrics() (backend/src/metrics/collector.py). backend/tests/metrics/test_metric_key_parity.py keeps this equal to the collector; frontend/src/test/metricGlossary.test.ts requires each key to be in frontend/src/metrics/catalog.ts or in 'excluded' with a reason.

excluded.vehicleLimit: The per-run vehicle-generation cap: a configuration echo, not a result.
excluded.ttcThresholdSeconds: The time-to-collision threshold in force: a configuration echo.
excluded.nearMissCooldownSeconds: The near-miss cooldown window in force: a configuration echo.
excluded.petThresholdSeconds: The post-encroachment-time threshold in force: a configuration echo.
